snippet.title: HITMAN World of Assassination - The Splitter  (featuring @JCVDWorld ) Mission Reveal
snippet.description:
🎥 Jean-Claude Van Damme, Movie Legend and Action superstar, steps into HITMAN World of Assassination as Max Valliant in our latest Celebrity Elusive Target mission. 
Max Valliant is a ruthless and unforgiving assassin whose only weakness seems to be his self-confidence; this won’t be like any other mission.

Play for free December 12th – January 12th

The new briefing is in.

#HITMAN #Agent47 #TheSplitter #JCVD #ActionLegend #jeanclaudevandamme #martialarts #vandamme
